root_cause.text: `nfsd_nl_listener_set_doit()` in the NFSD netlink listener setup path incorrectly used `get_current_cred()` when calling `svc_xprt_create_from_sa()`, leaking a credential reference because the returned `struct cred` was never released with `put_cred()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `get_current_cred()` to `current_cred()` in `fs/nfsd/nfsctl.c`, and the commit message explicitly states “nfsd_nl_listener_set_doit() uses get_current_cred() without put_cred()” while noting this path runs in process context (`sendmsg()`) so `current->cred` does not need an extra refcount.
